# Cost model results (round 8, generated by cost_model.py)

All usage numbers are unvalidated assumptions. Prices: AWS Frankfurt list prices, 2026-11-11, a comparison basis only. Savings and break-even hold only **under these assumptions**.

## AI variants: replaces T2 for a cluster that uses it (per cluster per month)

Boundary for every row: hardware or instance, power, hosting share and hardware maintenance. **Excluded everywhere:** staff time to run and update models, evaluation, spares, and the customer's own server. Capability is **not** equivalent: a 24 GB card runs smaller models than hosted Haiku or Sonnet, and quality is untested (PRD: compare local and hosted on the same cases).

Sources: L4 72 W and g6.xlarge $1.0064/h verified; Danny's $1,000 / 24 GB and $10,000 / 96 GB are his hypotheses (a $1,000 24 GB card is not verified); 96 GB cards listed at $14,080-16,000 (brief addendum, Codex). **NO SOURCE (AI placeholders):** consumer card 350 W, 96 GB card 600 W, 40% average load, PUE 1.5, electricity $0.15/0.25/0.35 per kWh, host share $20/$40, maintenance 10% a year, the 1 h/day warm window. GPU start-up delay is unverified.

| Variant | low | base | high |
|---|---|---|---|
| existing spare 24 GB datacenter GPU (L4-class, 72 W): power only | $4.73 | $7.88 | $11.04 |
| existing spare 24 GB consumer GPU (~350 W, assumption): power only | $23.00 | $38.33 | $53.66 |
| new 24 GB consumer GPU (~$1,000, Danny): 36-month amortisation + power + host share $20 + maintenance 10%/yr | $79.11 | $94.44 | $110 |
| new 96 GB GPU ($10,000 Danny / $15,000 Codex listing): amortisation + power (~600 W, assumption) + host share $40 + maintenance | $441 | $557 | $674 |
| EKS g6.xlarge (L4) always on | $735 | $735 | $735 |
| EKS g6.xlarge started on demand (0.15 unfamiliar problems/month x 0.5 h, plus 1 h/day warm window) | $0.08 | $30.27 | $60.46 |
| one model server per customer (g6.xlarge always on / 4 clusters per customer) | $184 | $184 | $184 |
| Hosted tokens, Haiku 4.5 regional (round 4) | $0.01 | $0.02 | $0.12 |
| No AI | $0 | $0 | $0 |
